commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Yunus Emre Konak comes onto the pitch after Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
90+6' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Brentford is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' Substitution. Chris Wood walks off the pitch and Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) comes on as a substitute.
90+2' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Neco Williams and he is replaced by Harry Toffolo (Nottingham).
90+2' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Matz Sels (Nottingham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
89' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
87' The foul by Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Michael Oliver.
87' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes a short corner kick.
84' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) for a tough tackle.
84' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
81' Substitution. Kevin Schade makes way for Fabio Carvalho (Brentford).
79' Jota Silva (Nottingham) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
79' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.

79' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
76' Jota Silva (Nottingham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Good work from Nottingham as they win a corner.
75' The referee signals a substitution. Jota Silva (Nottingham) is brought on as a substitute for Morgan Gibbs-White.
74' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brentford.
73' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Brentford will have a chance to score from a corner.
71' The resulting corner from Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) is cleared.

71' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball goes out of play. Nottingham are awarded a corner kick.
67' The game has come to an end for Kristoffer Ajer. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford).
67' The substitution has been made. Paris Maghoma (Brentford) has replaced Vitaly Janelt.
64' Nuno Espirito Santo prepares a substitution. Elliot Anderson is replaced by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Anthony Elanga leaves the pitch and Ryan Yates (Nottingham) comes on.
64' A corner kick by Brentford is thwarted by the well prepared Matz Sels (Nottingham).
62' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
61' The corner from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is intercepted by the defence.
61' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Brentford.
57' What was Yoane Wissa (Brentford) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
56' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
51' 0 - 2 GOAL! Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 0:2.
50' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

50' A precise low pass is received by Neco Williams (Nottingham), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
48' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
42' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
41' Ben Mee (Brentford) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Oliver blows for a foul.
40' Ben Mee (Brentford) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
38' 0 - 1 Goal! Ola Aina (Nottingham) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Neco Williams, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
36' Murillo (Nottingham) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

36' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Brentford will have a goal kick.
33' Mark Flekken leaps to intercept the corner kick from Elliot Anderson (Nottingham).

33' What a save from Mark Flekken! Chris Wood (Nottingham) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. Nottingham force a corner. They send men into the box.
30' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

29' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) meets a fine cross inside the penalty area from the resulting free kick and attempts to beat the keeper with a sweet header. That he does, but one of the defenders standing on the goal line manages to stop the effort going into the middle of the target.
27' Murillo (Nottingham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
27' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
24' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
22' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
22' A pass by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

21' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Yoane Wissa (Brentford), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nottingham.

19' Chris Wood (Nottingham) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Mark Flekken pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
18' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

18' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play and Nottingham manage to earn a corner.
15' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
13' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
13' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
9' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
8' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brentford comes to nothing.
7' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
5' The corner is swung in but Brentford can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

5' That was a nice football moment. Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the left post. Matz Sels guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The linesman points to the corner flag, Brentford are going to take it.
3' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Nottingham will have the kick-off.
Michael Oliver will referee today's match.
